implementation.name: original-v4-17-incident-evidence-lifecycle
implementation.scope: Schematic frame identities and independently retained event copies on the original incident-lifecycle diagram. One explicitly approved training branch; no measured timing or compliance verdict.
implementation.question: Which copy survives when routine frames expire?

purpose: Make routine-buffer deletion, incident retention, separate training authorization, and copy-specific expiry visible without replacing the original timeline or purpose branches.
storyboard: Expire A and trigger selection of B
Collect C and select event E
Review training request without authorizing a copy
Assume explicit approval and retain separate training E
guard: Event order, not measured duration. E denotes separate copies of the same selected window. Incident access does not authorize training; approval is an illustrative branch, not a legal or eligibility conclusion. Both copies have separate retention.
